text: This code is a straightforward and efficient implementation of the palindrome check. It uses a two-pointer approach, initializing one pointer at the start of the string and the other at the end. The pointers move towards each other, comparing characters at each step. If a mismatch is found, the function immediately returns False, indicating that the string is not a palindrome. If the pointers meet without finding a mismatch, the function returns True, confirming that the string is indeed a palindrome. This approach has a time complexity of O(n), making it suitable for large strings.
